_doc: tools/import_frames.gd: Spark's in-match side view, a template copied from Rookie's (art_source/characters/rookie/side_run/import.json): the run cycle frame_1.png .. frame_N.png here (any size, transparent background, facing right) and the ready pose ../side_ready/ready_v1.png. Run: $GODOT --headless --path . -s tools/import_frames.gd -- spark. Rookie's numbers tuned for his pictures: retune height, poses.ready.scale and add alignX / hands / gun / hand (see Rookie's config) when this character's pictures need them. See assets/README.md.

draw._doc: the ready pose, shown at once while the gun is out (gunDraw: no transition)

fire._doc: the shot from the ready pose: its frame with the recoil

gun._doc: angle per frame is added to the hold (+ = muzzle down). The gun is holstered in idle / walk in the match; carry: where it would be held (px from the feet pivot, source px). fists (optional, Rookie's config): the near fist per source frame, to sway the gun with the arm.

gunDraw._doc: gun_draw.gd TIMINGS overrides: the ready pose switches in and out at once

ready._doc: pose px: kneeling / ready to shoot, facing right, empty hands (the gun is placed by hand in `scene`). background: a checkerboard drawn into the pixels is removed. scale: source px per pose px (Rookie's 0.285 for a 2048 px pose next to 1280x720 run frames: the face as wide as in the run frames). Without alignX the pose's middle sits on the hips; without hands the hands stay in the body (under the gun); without gun the fallback seat is the pose's middle.
